class.name: NetwSchema
class.brief_description: One named typed column list, declared beside the code that writes it and compiled by every consumer that reads it.
class.description:
A schema is both the chain a [code]static var[/code] initializer runs and the data that chain leaves behind, because a game that had to terminate the chain to get the data was making a distinction it never wanted. [member columns] is the address order, and it is the address order every adopting session seals in, so two peers built from the same scripts agree on layout without negotiating it. Column methods return an [int] index because schema declarations have no session state. Each session creates its own [RID] for the schema. Use [method NetwMultiplayer.table_find] to retrieve it. [codeblock] class Mobs: static var schema := Netw.configure_schema(&"Mob") static var pos := schema.vector3( &"pos", NetwQuantizeScalar.new().limits(-512.0, 512.0).step(0.03), ) static var vel := schema.vector3(&"vel") # unquantized, the memcpy path static var hp := schema.u16(&"hp")
func _ready() -> void: mobs = Netw.of(self).table_find(Mobs.schema.schema_name) [/codeblock] A column with no quantizer crosses the wire as a raw little-endian copy of its buffer, which is the cheapest path in both directions. A quantizer buys bandwidth by paying per element, so reach for one on the columns a link actually cares about. One schema serves three consumers, so a declaration that only wants the database says so with [method replicated] and creates no table at all. [method NetwDatabase.declare_table] takes this object directly. [method variant] is the tier a table rejects and the other two accept. These method names are convenience and never freeze. They compile into [method NetwMultiplayer.schema_add_column] and [method NetwMultiplayer.schema_set_column_quantizer], which do.

method.name: boolean
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_BOOL] column, one bit per element on the wire.

method.name: color
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_COLOR] column.

method.name: column
method.description: Appends one column of an [enum NetwMultiplayer.ColumnType] named at runtime and returns its index, which is the wire address readers and writers both name it by. The typed verbs beside it are this call with the type filled in. A [param key] already declared with the SAME [param type] and [param stride] returns the index it already holds, which is what makes a script reload idempotent: every static initializer runs again and every column lands on the address it had. A [param key] already declared with a DIFFERENT shape returns [code]-1[/code] and appends nothing, because a column index is a stable wire address and silently shifting it would leave two peers reading each other's bytes at the wrong offsets.

method.name: create
method.description: Builds a schema under [param name] without listing it in the process-wide schema registry, for a consumer that types its own columns rather than publishing them. A caller that wants the registry's copy asks [method Netw.configure_schema] instead, and one holding a detached schema lists it later with [method register].

method.name: declare
method.description: Declares the schema named [param name] in the process-wide schema registry and returns it, or [code]null[/code] when the name is empty. Calling it twice for one name extends one declaration rather than making two, which is what lets a schema be declared beside each of the classes that write it. [method Netw.configure_schema] is the front door and this is what it returns.

method.name: entity
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_ENTITY] column of routes, the forward-only link one table draws to another.

method.name: f32
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_F32] column.

method.name: f64
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_F64] column.

method.name: i8
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_I8] column.

method.name: i16
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_I16] column.

method.name: i32
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_I32] column.

method.name: i64
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_I64] column.

method.name: is_reliable
method.description: Whether this schema's table commits ride the reliable lane, as [method reliable] left it. Meaningless while [method is_replicated] returns [code]false[/code].

method.name: is_replicated
method.description: Whether an adopting session creates a replicated table from this schema, as [method replicated] left it.

method.name: quaternion
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_QUATERNION] column, stored as a [PackedVector4Array] and read as [Quaternion] so [NetwQuantizeQuaternion] can pack it smallest-three.

method.name: register
method.description: Puts this declaration back in the process-wide schema registry if it is not listed there, and returns itself. A [code]static var[/code] initializer runs once and never again, so a holder that outlives a registry reset would otherwise keep a schema no session can find. Call this from the [method Node._ready] of whatever publishes the schema, which costs nothing when the declaration is already registered.

method.name: reliable
method.description: Sends this schema's table commits on the reliable lane and returns this schema. Read back through [method is_reliable]. Reach for it when a table changes rarely, because a rare-change table has no next commit to heal a lost datagram with. A table published every tick wants the default, where loss costs one row one tick of freshness.

method.name: replicated
method.description: Sets whether an adopting session creates a replicated table from this schema, and returns this schema. Read back through [method is_replicated]. Declaring a schema costs no wire on its own. Passing [code]false[/code] is how a schema that only types database columns says so, and the session skips the table, the wire id, and the frame budget entirely.

method.name: u8
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_U8] column.

method.name: u16
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_U16] column.

method.name: variant
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_VARIANT] column, the self-describing tier a [String] or a [Dictionary] takes. A schema holding one cannot become a table, because variable width has no memcpy and no rows-per-frame budget. Reach for it on a schema the database and the property binding consume, and leave the wire's fixed-width tier to the columns that can carry it.

method.name: vector2
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_VECTOR2] column.

method.name: vector3
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_VECTOR3] column.

method.name: vector4
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_VECTOR4] column.

members.member: The declared columns in address order. A consumer that types its own storage from a schema, as [method NetwDatabase.declare_table] does, reads this list.
The registered schema name used by [method NetwMultiplayer.schema_find].
